correctness.rationale: Full proof derived from unitary derivative correspondence for Sobolev space of functions vanishing at the root, exact edgewise -u''=k²u solutions, and complete Kirchhoff elimination for all 0<k<π/2. Cases c²-e s²=0 and !=0 exhaust the range, giving a simple ground eigenfrequency arctan(1/sqrt(de+d+e)) and a transverse eigenfrequency arctan(1/sqrt(e)) of multiplicity exactly d-1, with no intervening eigenvalues. Monotonicity and algebra prove all collision/inverse statements. Attached checker independently tests exact secular determinants and finite-element low eigenvalues on eight actual trees; finite tests are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Sharp Hardy L2 norm is a canonical functional-analytic stability invariant on metric trees, while inversion from low singular values is a natural inverse spectral question. The theorem classifies *all* first-norm collisions, including different-length metric trees, and shows first two singular values recover both combinatorial branching parameters. This supplies a complete natural-family inverse classification beyond a mere special numerical calculation; the exact second eigenspace multiplicity is additional structural information.
